subject: Clarifying actuation ownership and proposed RTO/RPO carveout for EU failover
body:
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finedge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@finedge.com
Date: Fri, 07 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request - EU regional failover RTO/RPO carveout

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the briefing yesterday. We are trying to finalize our continuity plan and have one ask: because of our EU data residency controls and multi-cloud routing, we need a temporary carveout to the standard multi-region RTO/RPO commitments for the Oslo region. Specifically, while we can tolerate warm-standby activation for edge traffic, we cannot guarantee synchronous replication across the Oslo <-> Dublin link inside 15 minutes for the next 12 months — there are network policy and vendor SLA limits on our side.

Can Redwood provide a short-term amendment that acknowledges a 45-minute RTO for failover activation from Oslo to Dublin, and an RPO up to 30 minutes for index state, while we complete our network upgrades? This affects only the warm-standby activation window; we still expect full SLA for hosted control-plane features.

We'd like to loop in your compliance team and legal; attaching our runbook for context.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Cloud Ops
FinEdge Payments
[Attachment: FinEdge_Runbook_excerpt.pdf (pdf)]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finedge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request - EU regional failover RTO/RPO carveout

Alex — thanks for the note and for the runbook excerpt. I appreciate the constraints; this is the kind of nuance we want captured formally rather than ad-hoc.

Karthik / Marissa / Naomi — can you take a look at FinEdge's ask? Key points: (1) carveout limited to Oslo->Dublin warm-standby activation only, (2) proposed temporary windows: RTO 45m, RPO 30m, (3) duration 12 months, (4) control plane SLAs unchanged.

I will prepare a proposed amendment draft for Legal once we align on operational mitigations and rollback conditions.

Irene
Sr. Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request - EU regional failover RTO/RPO carveout

Folks — I ran this against our regional-failover-matrix and the ask is implementable with constraints. Notes: 
- Activation path Oslo -> Dublin will need a prioritized routing policy to ensure prefetched KV caches are available; this adds ~8-12m in most cases but can spike.
- The 45m RTO is conservative and acceptable as a timeboxed exception if FinEdge accepts an availability-offset clause (reduced loss exposure) and increased monitoring/telemetry retention.
- RPO 30m for index state is feasible if we enable higher-frequency snapshotting for FinEdge's tenant group (cost impact estimated ~ +15% to storage IO).

I've attached a trimmed matrix showing failure modes and mitigation ownership. If Legal agrees to a temporary carveout and we surface required compensating controls (telemetry, runbook acceptance), we can sign this as a 12-month exception with quarterly review.

Attachment: regional-failover-matrix.xlsx

Karthik
Director, Serving Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finedge.com>, legal@finedge.com
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 10:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request - Request - EU regional failover RTO/RPO carveout

Alex / team — thanks for the patience. From an ops and contractual standpoint, here's a practical path:

1) Temporary Amendment: Redwood will issue a 12-month limited amendment that documents the exception scope (Oslo->Dublin warm-standby activation only), RTO 45m / RPO 30m, and the compensating controls: enhanced telemetry, prioritized routing, and weekly runbook validation drills.
2) Compensation & Credits: Because this increases our operational exposure, we propose a one-time platform credit of 2% of the monthly committed spend for the first two months after amendment signing.
3) Exit Criteria: Network upgrade confirmation from FinEdge OR successful pass of three consecutive weekly drills without incident.

I'll draft the amendment language and include the cost impact summary for Finance and Legal review.

-Marissa
Head of Customer Success (EMEA)
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finedge.com>, legal@finedge.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 09:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Draft amendment and next steps (FinEdge carveout proposal)

Alex — attaching the draft amendment and the failure-mode matrix for your review. High level: 12-month term, RTO 45 minutes for Oslo->Dublin warm-standby activation, RPO 30 minutes for index state, compensating controls as discussed, and an automated quarterly review clause. We included the 2% one-time credit language.

Please review the DocuSign link below for the amendment; I flagged the exit criteria in Section 3. If Legal has redlines please send them back to me directly.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/EXAMPLE-DS-209384
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleDriveLink

Irene

From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finedge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@finedge.com
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 15:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft amendment and next steps (FinEdge carveout proposal)

Irene / team — we reviewed the amendment with Legal. The scope and exit criteria look good; DocuSign signed by our VP of Engineering a few minutes ago. We accept the one-time credit.

Two quick asks: (1) can Redwood share a weekly calendar invite for the runbook validation drills (we prefer Tuesdays 10:00 UTC) and (2) confirm the telemetry retention settings you'll enable for our tenant so we can align with our audit team.

Thanks — I appreciate the clear path.
Alex
Head of Cloud Ops
FinEdge Payments
